name: Is hardwood flooring a good choice for kitchens and bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: Is hardwood flooring a good choice for kitchens and bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: While solid hardwood flooring is not typically recommended for high-moisture areas like bathrooms, it can be a suitable option for kitchens with proper precautions. Engineered hardwood, with its enhanced stability and moisture resistance, is often a better choice for kitchens and can even work in half-baths. Regardless of the type, prompt cleanup of spills is essential, and ensuring good ventilation can help minimize moisture damage in these areas.
